description: Demolition of existing garage and erection of two storey side extension, single storey rear extension and first floor rear extension.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [Fire strategy received 22/02/2023, PL2/SM/3289 - 00, PL2/SM/3289 - 01, PL2/SM/3289 - 02, PL2/SM/3289 - 03 Rev A, PL2/SM/3289 - 04 B, PL2/SM/3289 - 05, PL2/SM/3289 - 06 received 08/06/2023].

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.

Condition : 4 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification), no additional windows shall be inserted in any part of the development shall be constructed.
